text:
Great question! Unfortunately, there isn't a way to pay extra for faster delivery to your address. Express shipping ($14.95) isn't available in Zone 3, which covers addresses over 1,000 miles from our nearest greenhouse, so Standard shipping (5–8 business days) is the only option.

A few things that might help:

- **Order early in the week.** Live plants ship Monday–Wednesday only, and orders placed after 12 noon Wednesday ship the following Monday. Ordering Monday or Tuesday gets your plants on their way sooner.
- **Watch for weather holds.** If transit forecasts are below 35°F or above 95°F, live plants may be held up to 7 days, and we'll email you. In winter, you can add a free heat pack at checkout.
- **Standard shipping is free on orders of $75+** (after discounts, before tax), so that could save you the $7.95 fee.

I know waiting can be hard when you're excited for a new plant! Is there anything else I can help you with? 🌿
